cohort: 300 mothers conveniently chosen from four different primary health care centers in Baghdad between February 1, 2015, and May 31, 2015.
finding: Term labor was the most common pregnancy outcome across all age groups, while preterm labor rates were higher in younger mothers and abortion rates were higher in older mothers.
mod_finding: Cesarean section was the most common mode of delivery across all age groups, with higher rates in older mothers.
